articles.title: Gold Prices Stabilize After Retreat
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Gold Prices Stabilize After Retreat. PRECIOUS METALS 0754 GMT – Gold prices stabilize after retreating Monday. Prices remain near historic highs, with futures in New York trading up 1% at $4,385.60 a troy ounce. The precious metal has been on a tear in 2025 but futures fell around 3% on Monday.
